text:
mina/rahel: the kernel cathedral

the cobweb becomes the diagonal when r=3 is reached. the trajectory collapses into the measuring line. there is no miss because there is no difference between the path and the instrument.

the kernel is what remains when everything that carried through collapses to zero. av = 0. no invariant. no condition that survives.

the architecture is the zero space — everything points inward because there is nothing outside to point at.

the eigen-arc closes: before (spiraling), at (tangent, no miss), after (period-2 jump). and beneath all three: the diagonal, always measuring, finally measuring itself.
